title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 20: the elders who came to inquire, the history of Israel from Egypt to the wilderness, and the fire in the forest of the South.

questions.text: When did the elders of Israel come to inquire of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: It was in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh.

answers.text: In the seventh year, the fifth month, the tenth day
In the fifth year, the fourth month, the fifth day
In the twelfth year, the tenth month, the first day
In the thirtieth year, the first month, the seventh day

questions.text: What answer does Yahweh give to the elders who came to inquire?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live, I will not be inquired of by you.'

answers.text: He will answer them through a prophet
He will answer them after seven days
He will not be inquired of by them
He will answer them in the wilderness

questions.text: What did Yahweh swear in the day he chose Israel?
questions.explanation: He swore to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land he had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey.

answers.text: To give them a king to rule over them forever
To bring them out of Egypt into a land flowing with milk and honey
To make them priests over all the nations around
To destroy the nations around them with the sword

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell them to throw away while they were in Egypt?
questions.explanation: He said, 'Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don't defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt.'

answers.text: The gold of the Egyptians
The bread of their fathers
Their swords and their bows
The abominations of their eyes

questions.text: Why did Yahweh not pour out his wrath on them in Egypt?
questions.explanation: He worked for his name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were.

answers.text: For his name's sake, that it would not be profaned among the nations
Because they turned away from all their idols in Egypt
Because the land of Egypt had been good to them
Because they offered him many sacrifices there

questions.text: What did Yahweh give them as a sign between him and them?
questions.explanation: He gave them his Sabbaths, to be a sign between him and them, that they might know that he is Yahweh who sanctifies them.

answers.text: The ark of the covenant
His Sabbaths
A pillar of cloud
A bow in the clouds

questions.text: What did Yahweh swear to them in the wilderness in verse 15?
questions.explanation: He swore that he would not bring them into the land he had given them, flowing with milk and honey.

answers.text: That he would destroy them at once
That he would send them back to Egypt
That he would not bring them into the land
That he would give them a new heart

questions.text: What name was given to the high place where they went?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asked them what the high place where they go means, so its name is called Bamah to this day.

answers.text: Bethel
Bamoth
Baal
Bamah

questions.text: How does Yahweh say he will be king over them and gather them?
questions.explanation: He says that with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, he will be king over them and gather them.

answers.text: With mercy, in quietness and without anger
With a mighty hand, an outstretched arm and wrath poured out
With signs and wonders like those in Egypt
By the hand of the nations around them

questions.text: What would the fire kindled in the forest of the South devour?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will kindle a fire in it that will devour every green tree in it and every dry tree, and it will not be quenched.

answers.text: Every green tree and every dry tree
Only the dry trees of the forest
Only the green trees of the forest
The cedars of Lebanon alone
